definitions.explanation: A name adopted by an artist, poet, calligrapher, or other creative practitioner for use in their artistic work. Traditionally associated with Japanese and East Asian arts.

examples.japanese: {雅号|がごう}を{持|も}つ{画家|がか}。
examples.english: A painter who has an art name.

examples.japanese: {松尾芭蕉|まつおばしょう}の「{芭蕉|ばしょう}」は{雅号|がごう}である。
examples.english: "Basho" in Matsuo Basho is a pen name.

examples.japanese: {茶道|さどう}や{華道|かどう}の{師範|しはん}になると、{雅号|がごう}を{授|さず}かることがある。
examples.english: When you become a tea ceremony or flower arrangement master, you may be given an art name.

notes:
A compound of {雅|が} (elegance, refinement) and {号|ごう} (name, title). The {雅|が} character reflects the aesthetic and cultured nature of the name.

CULTURAL NOTE:
In traditional Japanese arts — poetry, painting, calligraphy, tea ceremony, and flower arrangement — practitioners adopt a {雅号|がごう} as part of their artistic identity. The name is often bestowed by a teacher or chosen to reflect artistic aspirations. Famous examples include {芭蕉|ばしょう} (Matsuo Basho) and {北斎|ほくさい} (Katsushika Hokusai).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雅号|がごう}を{名乗|なの}る — to use an art name
- {雅号|がごう}を{授|さず}かる — to receive an art name (from a master)
- {雅号|がごう}を{持|も}つ — to have an art name

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ペンネーム — pen name; used for modern writers, a loanword from English
- {筆名|ひつめい} — pen name; specifically for writers, more formal than ペンネーム
- {号|ごう} — name, title; the broader term that includes {雅号|がごう}
